title: Is it prime?
prompt:
Write `is_prime(n: u32) -> bool`. A prime is a number greater than 1 that is only divisible by 1 and itself.

```text
is_prime(2)  -> true
is_prime(9)  -> false
is_prime(17) -> true
is_prime(1)  -> false
```

hints: Numbers below 2 are never prime - handle them first.
Try dividing by every number from 2 up to `n - 1`. If one divides evenly (`n % d == 0`), `n` is not prime.
You can stop early: only test divisors `d` while `d * d <= n`. A `while` loop with a mutable `d` works well, and `return false;` leaves the function immediately.
explanation: If a number has a divisor bigger than its square root, it must also have a smaller one - so testing divisors only up to the square root is enough. Testing every number below `n` is slower but also correct.
